dataset: UCI Online Retail II (CC BY 4.0) with ECB euro reference rates

not_applied.clock_shift: the detector looks for one gateway's times written in UTC instead of IST; the shop records UK local time and has no gateways, so a planted shift would test the adapter, not a real failure
not_applied.key_fanout: the merchant table is made by the adapter (one row per country), not a real reference table
not_applied.orphan_code: the category codes are made by the adapter (GOODS and SERVICE), not a real code list
